unit_label: Section 12: Die Integritätsbasis der regulären Systeme S_{n rho} aus Polynomen
title_de: Die Integritätsbasis der regulären Systeme $\Ssys_{n\rho}$ aus Polynomen.
translation_source_policy: Translated directly from the audited German source slice. The English control slice was used only as a sanity witness for integrality-basis, regular-system, resultant, module-basis, and fundamental-point vocabulary; this unit was not edited from another target-language draft.

technical_exclusions.disposition: Section 13 and later Paper 06 content; not included in this checkpoint.

segment_summaries.content: Section title and immediate consequence of Sections 10 and 11: nonzero leading resultant makes the relatively integral domain first-kind and finite, with the involution basis as integrality basis.
segment_summaries.choices: Keeps first-kind rod/rid and integral-over terminology fixed from Sections 10 and 11.

segment_summaries.content: Hilbert-style second existence proof for the integrality basis using algebraically integral quantities, a rational basis, discriminant denominator, and Hilbert module-basis theorem; statement of Theorem VIII.
segment_summaries.choices: Rendered Modulbasis as module/modular basis in target registers; split formulas (3) and (5) for page safety.

segment_summaries.content: Generalization to the smallest containing integrality domain, Definition VIII of regular systems, and Theorem IX with Hilbert/nonregular counterexample footnote.
segment_summaries.choices: Regular system is regularna/regularnyj/regularny; nonregular example footnote preserved with equations.

segment_summaries.content: Geometric interpretation by homogenization and fundamental points; characterization of regular systems by absence of fundamental points.
segment_summaries.choices: Fundamentalpunkt becomes fundamental point/točka; Wertsystem continues as value-system/vrědnostij.
